app.name: TeOrganiza
dashboard.empty.title: Your home is empty
dashboard.empty.body: Pick widgets from the modules you have on to build your day.
settings.title: Settings
storage.drive.unavailable: Google Drive is not configured in this installation.
storage.drive.scopeNote: The app only sees the TeOrganiza folder it created itself. If you delete that folder and recreate it by hand, it will not be recognized.
storage.disconnect.note: The local copy stays on this device.
storage.revoke.note: The files on Drive are not deleted.
storage.notPersisted: The browser did not grant persistent storage: it may clear this data when space runs low.
sync.conflicts.title: Conflicting changes
sync.conflicts.body: These records were changed here and on another device. Pick which version stays. Nothing is written until you decide.
sync.first.title: First sync of this device
sync.first.body: This device and the destination both have data, and there is no way to tell which is newer. Choose:
sync.first.import.note: This device's data is replaced by the destination's.
sync.first.send.note: The destination ends up with exactly this device's data.
sync.first.merge.note: Combines both. Every record on both sides with different content becomes your choice.
sync.lock.title: Open on another device
sync.lock.body: Open on {device} for {minutes} minutes. Take over here?
home.allAdded: Every available widget is already on your home.
settings.modules.note: Turning a module off removes it from the navigation and the home. Its data stays and comes back when you turn it on again.
modules.disabled.title: {name} is turned off
modules.disabled.body: Turn the module on in Settings to use it. Its data was not deleted.
trash.title: Trash
trash.body: Nothing is really deleted: everything you remove lands here and can come back.
tags.title: Tags
tags.lead: Mark anything and find it all together
tags.body: A tag works across every module: #renovation gathers the expense, the note and the shopping list.
tags.empty.title: No tags yet
tags.empty.body: Create a tag while marking a transaction or any other record.
storage.folder.note: Your data goes into a TeOrganiza folder you choose, in files you can open without the app. It can live inside Dropbox or OneDrive.
storage.folder.unavailable: This browser cannot open folders. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.
storage.folder.disconnectNote: The folder and its files stay where they are; so does the local copy.
review.lead: Ten minutes on Sunday: the week in numbers, what went well, what got stuck and three priorities.
metrics.lead: Counted from the records themselves, over the last 30 days. Module-specific numbers (km, money, pages) come later.
nex.title: Nex
nex.setup: Nex uses your own Anthropic API key. Create one at console.anthropic.com and paste it here.
nex.privacy: The key stays in this browser and never goes to sync. Each question goes straight from here to Anthropic, with the recent records Nex needs to answer.
nex.hello: Ask about your day, or ask Nex to note, schedule or mark something.
nex.review.prompt: Give me a short summary of my week: what moved forward, what was left behind, and three priority suggestions for next week, based on my records and this week's review.
files.drop: or drop them here. Photos, PDFs, documents: any file.
files.missing: The content has not reached this device yet. Sync and try again.
files.lead: Everything you kept, loose or attached to notes, tasks, clients and transactions. With a destination, files travel to the folder or Drive too.
